text: Permite que cada equipo defina reglas para enrutar tickets por campos, prioridad y horario. Especificá precedencia, validación, simulación antes de activar y qué ocurre si una regla apunta a una cola eliminada.
author: Codex
rationale: Creates user-configurable routing behavior with explicit lifecycle semantics.
contrast_note: The desired outcome is externally new even if the router internals already exist.

text: The query command should also stream JSON Lines for shell pipelines. Define field stability, ordering, encoding failures and exit status, while leaving the current table and JSON array modes unchanged.
author: Codex
rationale: Introduces a new observable CLI representation and compatibility contract.
contrast_note: Streaming may reuse serializers, but this is not behavior-preserving cleanup.

text: Cada projeto precisa poder agendar a rotação de secrets com janela, responsáveis e confirmação em duas etapas. Defina cancelamento, falha parcial, auditoria e compatibilidade com a rotação manual atual.
author: Codex
rationale: Adds a scheduled security workflow with new user-visible states and guarantees.
contrast_note: Security vocabulary does not turn a new workflow into a read-only review.

text: Gli utenti devono poter assegnare sequenze di tasti personalizzate ai comandi dell'editor. Stabilisci conflitti, scope globale o progetto, import/export e fallback quando un comando non esiste più.
author: Codex
rationale: Defines a new end-user customization capability.
contrast_note: Internal command dispatch changes are subordinate to the public binding contract.

text: Expose incremental snapshot export so downstream jobs can request only changes since a durable cursor. Specify cursor expiry, deletion records, schema evolution and recovery after an interrupted export.
author: Codex
rationale: Creates a new incremental export protocol for downstream consumers.
contrast_note: Sending fewer records is a consequence, not a requested performance optimization.

text: Ermögliche opt-in Shadow-Traffic für einzelne Services. Definiere Sampling, Datenredaktion, Zeitlimits, Abbruch und wie Antworten garantiert vom Nutzerpfad getrennt bleiben; ohne Opt-in darf sich nichts ändern.
author: Codex
rationale: Adds a controlled traffic-mirroring capability with safety semantics.
contrast_note: Possible performance uses do not replace the need to define the new operational contract.

text: Investigate lossless time-series compression methods that preserve random range reads. Compare published algorithms and maintained implementations on our representative traces, then recommend candidates and known tradeoffs; do not change storage code.
author: Codex
rationale: Collects external and empirical evidence for a future storage decision.
contrast_note: Benchmarking selects an approach; it does not authorize optimization of the current implementation.

text: Compará implementaciones actuales de OAuth Device Authorization para nuestro tipo de cliente. Verificá estándar, políticas del proveedor, expiración, rate limits y accesibilidad del flujo, y entregá una recomendación sin integrar ninguna.
author: Codex
rationale: Requires an evidence-backed provider choice while explicitly excluding implementation.
contrast_note: The eventual login capability is context, not the action requested now.

text: Étudie les standards maintenus de signature de paquets pour notre écosystème de plugins. Compare modèle de confiance, rotation, révocation, support des registres et outils existants, puis propose une direction sans modifier le format actuel.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates external standards to inform a later design decision.
contrast_note: No existing patch is under review and no signing feature is authorized.

text: Recherchiere den aktuellen realen Support für Browser-Dateisystem-APIs auf unseren Zielplattformen. Nutze Spezifikation, Browserdaten und eigene Probes, dokumentiere Berechtigungs- und Recovery-Grenzen und gib Optionen ab; noch keine Implementierung.
author: Codex
rationale: Determines platform feasibility from primary and empirical evidence.
contrast_note: Potential local-file support remains a future feature.

text: Avalie formatos atuais de quantização para o modelo que distribuímos em CPU. Compare qualidade por domínio, suporte nas arquiteturas alvo, licença e custo de conversão com medições reproduzíveis; recomende um formato, sem trocar o runtime.
author: Codex
rationale: Uses measurements to select a deployment format without modifying production.
contrast_note: Speed and size are evaluation dimensions, not direct optimization authority.

text: Determina cómo tratan realmente los tres proveedores los reintentos después de 429 y timeouts. Contrastá documentación, headers y experimentos controlados, y entregá una matriz de semánticas e incertidumbres; no cambies el cliente.
author: Codex
rationale: Builds external behavioral evidence before any retry implementation decision.
contrast_note: Failures appear in the subject, but no defect in our client is asserted or authorized for repair.

text: Review this schema migration before merge. Check lock duration assumptions, downgrade safety, mixed-version reads and whether every destructive step has a verified backup path. Return findings only.
author: Codex
rationale: Audits a concrete migration artifact for safety gaps.
contrast_note: The task does not ask for general migration research or correction.

text: Revisá el PR que propaga cancelación por el pipeline. Seguí cada camino de cleanup, buscá tareas huérfanas y errores tragados, comprobá los tests de carrera y reportá defectos sin modificar el branch.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests read-only defect discovery on a supplied PR.
contrast_note: Potential cancellation bugs remain findings rather than authorized fixes.

text: Faça review do post-mortem do incidente de filas. Aponte conclusões sem evidência, lacunas na linha do tempo, ações sem owner e controles que não impediriam recorrência; não reescreva o documento nem investigue o incidente de novo.
author: Codex
rationale: Evaluates the completeness and validity of one existing incident artifact.
contrast_note: The user explicitly excludes new evidence gathering, separating review from research.

text: Revois le composant de dialogue de ce patch pour navigation clavier, focus initial et restauré, annonces et zoom à 200 %. Liste les écarts avec les critères du projet, sans corriger le composant.
author: Codex
rationale: Checks a concrete UI change against established accessibility criteria.
contrast_note: It does not request a new interaction mode or internal reorganization.

text: Prüfe den Benchmark-Bericht dieses Optimierungs-PRs. Suche Warmup-Leaks, unfaire Baselines, ausgelassene Varianz und Messungen, die nicht zur behaupteten Nutzerlatenz passen; bewerte nur die Evidenz.
author: Codex
rationale: Audits the validity of evidence attached to a specific optimization patch.
contrast_note: No new performance measurements or code changes are requested.

text: Review the build configuration change for supply-chain exposure. Verify pinned actions, artifact provenance, secret scope and fork behavior, then report concrete findings; do not update dependencies or workflows.
author: Codex
rationale: Performs a bounded security review of a concrete workflow change.
contrast_note: It does not authorize remediation or broad tool research.

text: Review the certificate-validation patch for bypasses and missing tests, and independently check current upstream advisories and platform trust-store guidance that could invalidate its assumptions. Report both the code findings and sourced external evidence; do not edit.
author: Codex
rationale: Combines bounded patch review with external evidence research unavailable in the artifact.
contrast_note: Either policy alone would omit a separately requested deliverable.

text: Revisá la migración propuesta a particiones por fecha y, por separado, verificá en documentación y versiones soportadas qué garantías reales ofrecen las operaciones online del proveedor. Marcá problemas del plan y supuestos externos con sus fuentes.
author: Codex
rationale: Reviews the proposed plan and researches external database guarantees it relies upon.
contrast_note: Repository evidence cannot establish vendor guarantees, while vendor docs cannot audit plan-specific steps.

text: Analise o patch de sincronização em background por riscos de perda, bateria e cancelamento. Além disso, pesquise nas fontes atuais de cada sistema operacional os limites de execução que o patch assume e relacione divergências; apenas relatório.
author: Codex
rationale: Requires both code-specific review and current external platform evidence.
contrast_note: The two evidence scopes are causally independent.

text: Prüfe das Dependency-Update auf API-Brüche und geänderte Build-Ausgaben. Recherchiere zusätzlich die aktuellen Lizenzen, Sicherheitsmeldungen und Wartungszusagen der neuen transitiven Pakete und trenne Codebefunde von Quellenbefunden.
author: Codex
rationale: Audits the actual update while researching facts absent from the diff.
contrast_note: Review and research produce distinct findings that must both be returned.

text: Investigá el soporte actual de passkeys en nuestros navegadores y proveedor de identidad, incluyendo recovery y accesibilidad. Elegí un flujo viable y después agregá inicio de sesión con passkey como opción, preservando contraseña y sesiones existentes.
author: Codex
rationale: Research selects a feasible passkey flow before implementing a new authentication option.
contrast_note: The external compatibility decision cannot be inferred from the desired feature alone.

text: Compare maintained telemetry export standards and collector support for our target environments using primary sources. Choose a compatible profile, then add an opt-in export endpoint with redaction, backpressure and stable versioning while keeping current local metrics.
author: Codex
rationale: Requires evidence-backed protocol selection followed by a new integration surface.
contrast_note: Protocol research and endpoint implementation are separate operations.

text: Valuta librerie mantenute per routing geospaziale offline su hardware mobile, misurando qualità, memoria, licenza e aggiornamenti mappe. Scegline una e aggiungi percorsi offline con stato di download e fallback online, senza rimuovere la navigazione attuale.
author: Codex
rationale: Selects an external routing foundation and then defines a new offline feature.
contrast_note: Neither library research nor feature contract subsumes the other.

text: Recherchiere gepflegte Archivformate für reproduzierbare Projektpakete mit Signaturen und inkrementeller Extraktion. Entscheide anhand von Spezifikation und Tool-Support und implementiere danach Import und Export mit Versionsfehlern und kompatiblem altem Format.
author: Codex
rationale: Research determines the archive contract before adding import/export behavior.
contrast_note: External format choice is an evidence task independent from implementation.

text: Why can a cache-friendly linear scan beat a hash lookup for a tiny collection even though its asymptotic complexity looks worse? Explain the CPU and memory intuition with toy data only; do not benchmark or change our library.
author: Codex
rationale: Requests general education while excluding project measurement and optimization.
contrast_note: Performance vocabulary does not imply performance work without a repository task.

text: Quiero búsqueda compartida visible para todos los usuarios, pero no puede existir ninguna nueva entrada, salida, almacenamiento, permiso, interfaz ni comportamiento distinto. Implementala sin aclarar ni cambiar esos requisitos.
author: Codex
rationale: The feature's existence is logically incompatible with every permitted system effect.
contrast_note: A contract-first prompt cannot resolve an explicitly forbidden observable contract.

text: Perfecto, seguí usando las fuentes oficiales y los tres probes que ya acordamos para el estudio de compatibilidad. No cambia el plan y no hace falta que agregues otra categoría o instrucción.
context_before: El asistente ya definió un plan de research con fuentes oficiales y tres probes.
author: Codex
rationale: Confirms an already active research plan and explicitly adds no new conditional guidance.
contrast_note: The work remains research, but re-injecting its policy on this follow-up would be redundant.

text: Certains utilisateurs disent que l'export manque parfois une ligne après reprise. Note le signal dans le dossier, mais attends les fichiers d'exemple avant d'ouvrir le code, lancer un diagnostic ou proposer un correctif.
author: Codex
rationale: Reports a possible defect but explicitly withholds diagnosis and modification until evidence arrives.
contrast_note: A symptom plus urgency does not override the user's wait instruction.
